name: Kibberia Fresh Foods
old_description: Commercial kitchen offering over 350 products from around the world!
about:
Kibberia Foods operates commercial kitchens in Danbury, Connecticut and Lafayette, Louisiana. The company was founded by Carole Iskandar and her husband Sam, who began as restaurant owners in Danbury over a decade ago serving authentic Mediterranean cuisine. The business is family owned and operated. In 2021, they expanded to Lafayette to serve southeastern retailers.

The company produces more than 350 recipes, including an established line of 250-plus SKUs of all-natural, restaurant-quality prepared foods. Its capabilities include recipe research and development, rapid scale-up from concept to mass production within a week, and large-scale production with same-day ingredient processing. Facilities are SQF and HACCP certified, USDA inspected, and FSMA-ready.

Kibberia Foods supplies large retailers and supermarkets, offering products in individual, family-size, and food-service packaging. The company collaborates with retail partners to develop private-label lines and adjusts formulations for target price points, seasonal demand, and demographic preferences.

Founder Carole Iskandar’s Mediterranean heritage and commitment to food safety drive the mission to deliver fresh, healthy, nutritious food at cost-effective prices. The company emphasizes a boutique approach to recipe creation, donates surplus food to local charities, and maintains annual performance audits to ensure quality.
